hypothesis: Wet-curve failures are overspeed past the friction limit. A moderate global alpha_v bias cut (-0.8) combined with a wet-gated extra cut (h1 unit 60 as low-friction detector feeding nominal-dead h2 units with strongly negative alpha_v weights) keeps lateral acceleration under the limit.
expected_effect: Lat accel ratio below 1.0 on wet-curve seeds (10/10 passed in rollouts, max ratio 0.95) while nominal driving is kept (3/3 nominal seeds passed with score 100). The gated path adds zero shift on nominal states offline.
